import datetime as dt, hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
lower=dt.datetime.fromisoformat(sys.argv[1])
upper=dt.datetime.fromisoformat(sys.argv[2])
expected=int(sys.argv[3])
roots=[
'/root/embedding-optimizer-v3-experiment/launch/evaluation-handoff/pool-a/jobs',
'/root/embedding-optimizer-v3-experiment/launch/evaluation-handoff/pool-b/jobs']
listed=subprocess.run(['rg','--files','-g','*.exited.json',*roots],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
receipts=[]
for line in listed.stdout.splitlines():
    path=Path(line)
    if str(path.parent) not in roots or path.is_symlink() or not re.fullmatch(r'verified-v3-[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.exited\.json',path.name):
        raise ValueError('Unexpected native exit receipt target')
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    record=json.loads(raw)
    finished=dt.datetime.fromisoformat(record['finished_at_utc'])
    if not lower < finished <= upper:
        continue
    run,step,task=record['job']
    if path.name != f'{run}-{step}-{task}.exited.json':
        raise ValueError('Native exit receipt job/path mismatch')
    receipts.append({'path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),**record})
receipts.sort(key=lambda row:row['finished_at_utc'])
